note: The launch report has a caution tier. Drogue descent and opening shock are now three levels instead of two: up to 70 ft/s says nothing, 70 to 90 ft/s is an amber caution that says it is above the preferred rate but still inside the accepted band, and above 90 ft/s is a red warning. Before this, one foot per second over read exactly as loudly as forty over. The other safety lines are coloured to match, so nothing looks more serious than it is. Also: two corrected shock-cord materials are available as an option - OpenRocket's own table lists 3/4 inch flat elastic as lighter than 1/16 inch round, which sizes a parachute against a rocket about 100 g light on a typical harness. The original entries are untouched, so .ork files still agree with desktop OpenRocket.
